caption: The drawing features a single shoe depicted in profile view, occupying the lower right portion of the image. The shoe is predominantly black, with pinkish-red trim along the upper edge and the strap, as well as decorative pinkish-red patterns on the toe area, which are outlined and detailed with black, gray, and white. The strap across the ankle has a button closure. Above the shoe, two smaller outline sketches are shown: one is a top-down view displaying an ornamental design on the upper part of the shoe, and the other is a bottom view showing the sole and its markings. The background is a plain, light beige color, and the overall composition is centered with the main shoe on the bottom right and the outline drawings above and to the left.
title: Baby Shoe
